title: Proper refinement graph and its neighborhood transports
statement: For schemes $X,Y$, a morphism $f:X\to Y$, compactifications $s,r$ of $f$ and a refinement $\rho:r\to s$, let $T=r.Z\times_Y s.Z$, $z=(1,\rho):r.Z\to T$, and $p=\mathrm{pr}_1;r.g:T\to Y$. Let $O_1=T\times_{s.Z}X$ and $O_2=T\times_{r.Z}X$ with open maps $b_1,b_2$ to $T$, and the fixed graph lifts $s_1,s_2:X\to O_1,O_2$ of [def-pur-etale-graph-presentation-maps]. For a finite commutative ring $A$, define transport$_i$ as the specified Cartesian proper/open exchange $Rs_{i*}Db_{i!}\to Dr.i_!Rz_*$, whiskered by $Rp_*$ and composed with the specified $Rz_*Rp_*\cong Rr.g_*$. Define the middle word as the specified graph intersection isomorphism whiskered by $Rp_*$, with its associators. All maps are literal constructions, not choices of endpoint isomorphisms. Their geometric well-definedness is supplied by the named theorems recorded in the pointer lem-pur-etale-refinement-graph-cartesian.
